# I Sketch Interiors

> Luxury interior design studio based in Thane, Maharashtra, India. Specialising in bespoke residential interiors across Mumbai, Pune, and internationally.

## About
- Founded: Est. 2000
- Experience: 20+ years, 125+ completed projects
- Services: Full Interior Design, Consultation, Property Styling, Bespoke Joinery
- Location: The Courtyard, Asteria A/604, Pokhran Road No. 2, Thane West, Maharashtra, India
- Contact: studio@isketchinteriors.com | +91 99673 12203

## Services
- Full Interior Design: Comprehensive service from concept to installation including space planning, material selection, furniture design, and project management.
- Consultation: Expert guidance on colour schemes, furniture layouts, lighting design, and material choices.
- Property Styling: Transform properties for sale or rental with curated furnishings and accessories.
- Bespoke Joinery: Custom-designed cabinetry, built-in storage, kitchen design, and statement pieces.

## Featured Projects
- Belgravia Townhouse, London — 6,500 sq ft Georgian townhouse renovation
- Surrey Country Estate — 12,000 sq ft country estate redesign
- Dubai Penthouse — 8,000 sq ft contemporary luxury penthouse
- Chelsea Apartment, London — 2,200 sq ft pied-à-terre
- Kensington Kitchen, London — 450 sq ft bespoke kitchen
- Notting Hill Residence, London — 4,800 sq ft townhouse transformation
